title: # PHASE 1 — PROJECT UNDERSTANDING AND PLANNING
name: PROJECT UNDERSTANDING AND PLANNING
content:
# PHASE 1 — PROJECT UNDERSTANDING AND PLANNING\
\
Understand the following product requirements before development.\
\
LeadNexus AI X is a simple B2B lead research platform.\
\
The primary workflow:\
\
1. User enters a search query.\
2. System displays dropdown suggestions.\
3. User selects search criteria.\
4. User confirms criteria.\
5. System searches for relevant companies and decision-makers.\
6. Search results are displayed.\
7. User clicks Add on selected leads.\
8. Selected leads are stored in PostgreSQL.\
9. User opens Saved Leads.\
10. User exports saved leads to CSV or Excel.\
\
CRITICAL BUSINESS RULE:\
\
Only leads explicitly added by the user are saved and exported.\
\
Temporary search results must never be included in the Saved Leads page or exports.\
\
Keep the application focused on this workflow.\
\
Do not build a full CRM, sales pipeline, marketing automation platform, or unnecessary enterprise modules.\
\
Before changing an existing workspace, inspect its contents and preserve existing working code.\
\
---\

title: # PHASE 7 — REAL-WORLD LEAD SEARCH INTEGRATION
name: REAL-WORLD LEAD SEARCH INTEGRATION
content:
# PHASE 7 — REAL-WORLD LEAD SEARCH INTEGRATION\
\
Create a modular search-provider architecture.\
\
Support integrations with authorized sources such as:\
\
- Public company websites.\
- Official business APIs.\
- Public GitHub repositories.\
- GitHub Issues.\
- GitHub Pull Requests.\
- GitHub Discussions.\
- Public job postings.\
- Authorized business directories.\
- Approved lead data providers.\
\
The architecture must allow additional providers to be added later.\
\
For every search result, preserve:\
\
- Provider name.\
- Source URL.\
- Evidence.\
- Retrieval date.\
- Matching search criteria.\
\
Data quality rules:\
\
1. Never fabricate companies.\
2. Never fabricate decision-makers.\
3. Never generate fake email addresses.\
4. Never invent phone numbers.\
5. Never fabricate source URLs.\
6. Distinguish verified from unverified contact details.\
7. Show unavailable fields as Not Found.\
8. Respect source terms, rate limits, access restrictions, and privacy laws.\
9. Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, or CAPTCHAs.\
10. Do not claim live integration is operational without credentials and successful testing.\
\
Use environment variables for API credentials.\
\
If credentials are unavailable, implement the provider interface and clearly show that the integration requires configuration.\
\
Do not present sample data as real search results.\
\
